tasks.title: HANGS Construction · FY2026 Year-End Audit
tasks.description: Audit HANGS Construction Development LP's FY2026 books from 16 Excel, PDF, Word and email files: the client's books, the vendors' invoices and the letters the bank and the escrow company sent the audit team directly. Propose materiality, vouch a seeded sample, search for unrecorded bills, test every journal, tie cash to the bank and compare the year with last year. Produce formula-linked workpapers with tickmarks and a draft findings memo. The CPA reviews, decides every open item and concludes; the machine gives no opinion. A little under 4 minutes with pauses added for viewing; the real work, about half a minute, is shown separately.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with tickmarks and evidence tabs, and a draft findings memo PDF for the CPA with evidence trails and the original files attached
tasks.gates: Draft workpapers and findings, not reviewed, concluded or signed. Not an audit report and no opinion. Open items stay open. The CPA concludes.
tasks.periodLine: FY2026: July 1, 2025–June 30, 2026 · year-end audit workpapers and findings for the CPA.
